description: This PHP source file contains utility functions for minifying, concatenating, backing up, and restoring JavaScript files within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM environment. It includes functions for handling file operations, minification via external libraries, and managing backup directories.

methods.name: get_exclude_files
methods.description: Returns a predefined array of file and folder paths to be excluded from minification or processing, optionally prepending a prefix.

methods.name: ConcatenateFiles
methods.description: Concatenates grouped JavaScript source files into single files, handling minification and file permissions.

methods.name: create_backup_folder
methods.description: Creates a nested backup directory structure based on a given path, specifically for backing up JavaScript source files.

methods.name: CompressFiles
methods.description: Uses external minification libraries to minify a JavaScript file, preserving license comments and handling file backups.

methods.name: reverseScripts
methods.description: Restores JavaScript files from backups, copying them back to their original locations, and creating backups if needed.

methods.name: BackUpAndCompressScriptFiles
methods.description: Recursively processes directories to back up and minify JavaScript files, respecting exclude lists and optionally backing up original files.
